introduction: Delaware Medicaid helps eligible residents pay for medical care. Apply through ASSIST and read current eligibility notices carefully.
description: Delaware Medicaid helps eligible residents pay for medical care. Apply through ASSIST and read current eligibility notices carefully.

sections.who: Eligibility varies by age, household circumstances, income and applicable status rules. The state announces noncitizen-rule changes effective October 1, 2026; ask how the current policy applies to each applicant.
sections.get: Covered services include medical visits, hospital care, prescriptions and other authorized care. Many members receive care through Diamond State Health Plan managed care.

sections.apply:
1. Apply through ASSIST

    Start at Delaware ASSIST.

  2. Review current coverage rules

    Use the state’s eligibility page and linked Medicaid ENGAGE information.

  3. Respond to follow-up

    Submit requested records and read the determination for each household member.
sections.after: Keep contact information updated and retain renewal notices. Ask a provider to confirm coverage before arranging care.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Delaware Medicaid eligibility; ASSIST application. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
